script.topic: 3 GPU buying myths that waste your money
script.hook: Before you buy your next graphics card, stop falling for these money-wasting myths.
script.narration: Before you buy your next graphics card, stop falling for these money-wasting myths. First, assuming more video memory automatically means higher speed. Extra VRAM cannot compensate for a slow graphics processor. Second, paying huge price premiums for factory overclocked cards. You are usually spending extra money for gains you will never notice while playing. Third, buying a budget GPU just for ray tracing capabilities. Entry-level cards often suffer huge performance drops when heavy ray tracing is turned on. Always check independent gaming benchmarks for the core processor instead of trusting glossy box features and marketing hype.
